escenas.texto: Which was the most liked video in the world this week? Here is the podium. Watch until the end.
In third place, Okay but who wins…?! 👀🌅🛌, by Sophia & Noelle, with over 657 thousand likes.
In second place, COMPRÉ A MINI MINI.ULTRA EN LA DEEP WEB, by Fede Vigevani, with over 727 thousand likes.
And number one: Trap Door Roulette, by MrBeast, with over 1 million likes.
The full countdown, from ten to one, is already on the channel. Find it in the description. Hashtag Top 10 RS.
